WITH account_region_signed AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount 
        WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount 
        ELSE NULL 
    END) as signed_total,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
regional_sums AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(signed_total) as regional_total
  FROM account_region_signed
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  ars.account_id,
  ars.region,
  ars.signed_total,
  ars.record_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN ars.signed_total IS NULL OR rs.regional_total IS NULL OR rs.regional_total = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(ars.signed_total AS REAL) / CAST(rs.regional_total AS REAL)
  END as ratio
FROM account_region_signed ars
JOIN regional_sums rs ON ars.region = rs.region
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
